title: growth-hypothesis-1on1-scratch - Alex Herrera - Sep 04 2028
content:
Context / purpose:
- 1:1 with report (Sam) focused on career trajectory + a short sync on the runtime perf experiments Sam is leading (kv cache + microbatching).
- Goal: leave with clear next actions for Sam (career stretch), my ask to eng leads, and confirm priorities for next sprint.

High-level agenda (30–40m)
1) Check-in (5m) — personal pulse, bandwidth, any immediate blockers.
2) Career/compass (10–12m) — stretch goals, visibility plan, internal mentoring.
3) Project deep dive (12–15m) — kv-cache experiment status, perf numbers, roll forward decision.
4) Roadmap alignment & blockers (5–8m) — what needs unblock from me or infra.
5) Action items + quick calendar sync (2–3m).

Pre-read notes for me:
- Sam pushed new microbatcher prototype; initial perf table in GH PR (GH-PR-4893). Looks promising on p40 (12% token latency drop) but tail latency increased on small seq lengths. Need to understand distribution effect.
- Career: Sam asked about moving into tech lead role for runtime team in 2 quarters. Wants to own small feature area and run at least one on-call rotation.

Questions I want to ask Sam (direct + probing):
- Personal: energy level, recent wins/frustrations, any signals they want me to share in upwards conversations?
- Career: which concrete outcomes would show readiness for TL (mentorship, docs, owning rollout)? Which support do they want from me?
- Project: what’s the leading hypothesis for tail latency regression? Repro steps? Are there perf regressions on dedicated infra or only hosted containers?
- Blockers: infra quota / test infra / profiling access / mentor time. Which of these is blocking now?

Red flags to watch for (call out explicitly if they appear)
- Sam deflects career asks -> indicates either insecurity or lack of clarity. Follow-up: make a 3-month plan with discrete milestones.
- Project health: PR sits >3 days without review, flaky perf tests, inconsistent benchmarking.

Data points I should bring to the meeting:
- GH-PR-4893 notes + perf table (p95, p99, mean) — summarize top-line numbers.
- Link to reproducer script + steps.
- Recent oncall blip logs if any (SRE thread link).

Draft talking script / prompts (short)
- "Tell me three things you want me to know since our last 1:1 — one win, one annoyance, one risk."
- "For the TL ask: what would you own first? Who on the team would you lean on?"
- "Walk me through the experiment: where does the p99 blow up? Steps to reproduce?"

Proposed career stretch plan (1 pager sketch to sync)
- Quarter 1: Lead microbatching effort — own design doc, run canary, present postmortem.
- Quarter 2: Rotate into runtime oncall shadow -> primary oncall for a week.
- Support: weekly 30m mentor slot with Priya, visibility: present at infra sync, promotion dossier prep at end of Q2.

Project: microbatcher + KV cache experiment notes (talking bullets)
- Hypothesis: batching across requests + prefix caching reduces tokens served by ~18% for common user distributions.
- Observed: mean latency down 12% on dev p40; p99 increased on short-seq (<=64) due to batching delay window.
- Mitigation options: dynamic batch window (adaptive), sequence-length-aware routing (fast-path for <64), conservative fallback for hosted low-latency customers.
- Decision needed: do we land microbatcher behind feature flag + adaptive default, or continue tuning for tail?

Immediate unblock requests (from Sam) that I need to action or escalate:
- Extra perf engineer 0.2 FTE for two sprints to instrument tail path (JIRA-8721).
- Temporary higher-priority CI slot to run full perf matrix (16k runs).
- OK to present canary plan to product for limited rollout next sprint (ask: my approval).

Follow-ups / Action items (to create during meeting + assign)
- Sam: finalize repro steps + upload perf artifacts to GH PR (due: 2028-09-07).
- Me (Alex): ping infra leads (Noah) to request perf engineer support & CI slot; escalate JIRA-8721 if no response by 09/06.
- Priya: 30m mentoring commit (weekly); I will loop Priya in after meeting.
- Sam + Alex: draft TL readiness checklist (1 pager) — due 2028-09-18.
- Ops: schedule canary window (if approved) in staging for 2028-09-20 — note: need compliance run.

Notes-to-self / meeting signals to capture live:
- Time stamps where Sam hesitates on TL specifics -> flag for follow-up.
- Exact repro commands and which infra type shows regression.
- Any stakeholder risk (product wanting faster rollout -> conflict with reliability).

Loose parking lot items (if time allows)
- Discuss Sam leading a short brown-bag on microbatching internals. Good for visibility.
- Quick ask: would Sam be open to writing a short blog-post-level summary of the experiment for internal comms?

Post-meeting template I will use to follow up (quick Slack + doc):
- Short summary: decisions we made, owners, dates. Link GH PR + JIRA.
- Ask: who should be looped into the canary (SRE, product, compliance).

Tone / approach note: be direct but growth-oriented. Push for concrete outcomes; avoid abstract encouragement without specifics.

End of scratchpad.

-- Alex
